audit_items.proof_trace: The EMA deviation check (get_price_with_check) is correctly enforced in borrow/withdraw collateral and debt valuation paths (L1198, L1284). However, liquidate_calculate_seize_ctokens (L1045-1046) fetches raw spot prices via get_spot_price — with no EMA deviation guard — for both the debt and collateral tokens, allowing flash-loan-manipulated spot prices to directly determine the collateral seizure amount. The seize formula seizeAmount = repayAmount * price_borrowed_spot / price_collateral_spot is fully exposed to spot price manipulation.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker composes a Sui PTB: (1) take a flash loan to drain a DEX pool and suppress the spot price of collateral token, (2) call refresh_usd_price to push the suppressed spot price into XOracle, (3) liquidate a legitimately underwater obligation — the seize calculation uses the deflated collateral spot price so 2x or more collateral is seized per unit of debt repaid, extracting excess value from the borrower; repay the flash loan with profit.
